stock.description: Kelfred Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding entity primarily engaged in the creation and sale of eyewear. The firm produces a diverse array of spectacle frames and sunglasses, largely leveraging original design manufacturing (ODM) and original equipment manufacturing (OEM) models. Its comprehensive offerings span from product conceptualization and sourcing of raw materials to the manufacturing process, rigorous quality assurance, packaging, and final distribution. Additionally, Kelfred markets its proprietary 'Miga' brand items and participates in the general trading of eyewear merchandise. Established in 1986 and headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong, the company boasts a significant international presence, conducting operations across the People's Republic of China, Italy, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Spain, Hungary, the United States, and other global markets.
